name: AI assistant
author: Brett
description: The framework's assistant (assistant@1) in the Dev Console: every provider in the shared registry (Anthropic, Claude Code subscription, OpenAI, xAI Grok, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Together, Fireworks, Perplexity, Cohere, Cerebras, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, any OpenAI-compatible server), setup wizard in Settings → Plugins → AI assistant, settings dialog inside the chat, live sessions on an open host registry, write-mode approval cards, the Claude Code MCP bridge. Its title bar shows axHub approvals and held calls (lib-approvals badge: click to approve on the hub page, or Deny before a countdown ends). Chats as an agent from an installed agent manager. Hub users (behind axHub's sign-in wall) chat at /api/plugins/ai-assistant/app with permissions from the hub's users page. Drives the console through control@1 (tool group Console: open any screen, dialog or settings tab, read and change any setting, run console actions and plugin commands, file builds, every control@1 target). Hands-free voice: one switch (top of its settings, the mic toggle in every chat header, REST /hands-free, MCP ai-assistant_hands-free, CLI axf ai-assistant hands-free) for always-listening wake or talk mode with spoken replies. Runs inside Molly too: Molly's AI assistant plugin frames this plugin's chat page and owns it, so the console never renders a second copy there.
